'''Herron Morvis''' was an influential economist during the [[Restoration Period]] and the [[Mandalorian Wars]]. In [[3985 BBY]], he authored the [[Coruscant Financial Exchange Establishment Act]] which helped the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] rebuild its infrastructure following the devastation caused by the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]]. Once he had successfully established the [[Coruscant Financial Exchange]], he served as the organization's director.

His [[Morvis (senator)|wife]] was the [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] from [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]] and his son was [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Dallan Morvis]] of the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]].
